prompt: Build an FAQ section where the user clicks a question and it expands to reveal the answer below it. Several questions should be grouped together.

samples.response:
<bl-accordion-group>
  <bl-accordion caption="What is Baklava?" icon="info">
    Baklava is a web-component design system for building accessible user interfaces.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I install it?" icon="info">
    Install the package and import the component bundle into your application entry point.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="Is it framework agnostic?" icon="info">
    Yes. Because Baklava ships as custom elements, it works with any framework or with no framework at all.
  </bl-accordion>
</bl-accordion-group>

<bl-accordion-group multiple>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I create an account?" icon="info">
    Click "Sign up" in the top bar, enter your email and a password, then verify your email from the confirmation message we send you.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I reset my password?" icon="info">
    On the sign-in screen choose "Forgot password". We will email you a secure reset link that expires in 30 minutes.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="Is my payment information safe?" icon="info">
    Yes. Payment details are encrypted in transit and at rest, and we never store your full card number on our servers.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="Can I cancel my subscription anytime?" icon="info">
    Absolutely. You can cancel from Billing & Plans at any time, and you keep access until the end of the current billing period.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I contact support?" icon="info">
    Open the chat bubble at the bottom right or email support@example.com. Our team replies within one business day.
  </bl-accordion>
</bl-accordion-group>

<bl-accordion-group>
  <bl-accordion caption="What is Baklava?">
    Baklava is a web-component design system built with the Open Web Components stack.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I install it?" open>
    Install the package with your favorite package manager and import the components you need.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="Does Baklava support TypeScript?">
    Yes. All Baklava components ship with full TypeScript definitions and a custom-elements manifest.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I get support?">
    Join the community channel and ask a question; maintainers and users are happy to help.
  </bl-accordion>
</bl-accordion-group>
